name: education
title: Home Education Hub
description: Cloud9 -- the kid dashboard: AI homework helper, planner, dictionary, weather labs, video shelf, and a link into the full Kolibri course library.
notes: Kolibri is a full learning-platform stack -- heavy, desktop/laptop-class hardware recommended, not a Pi target (see ROADMAP.md Phase 1). Cloud9's AI homework helper shares Citadel's own Ollama engine (the 'ai' module's) instead of bundling a private model -- enabling this module alone starts Ollama automatically, no need to also turn on 'ai'.
